title: The worklist is a Maintenance reminders tab under Customers
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. Enough rows to scroll: a schedule "Worklist load" with three services, "W30" (Every 30 days), "W60" (Every 60 days) and "W90" (Every 90 days); bulk-enrol all 22 assets of one customer on it with blank last service dates (customer Assets tab > Enroll in Schedule > Select all > Enroll 22 assets). That gives 22 × 3 = 66 rows, all due within 91 days.
custom_steps:
1. Open Customers from the top navigation; find the "Maintenance reminders" tab and open it.
  2. On the Customers tab type a term in the search (e.g. "Greenhills"), switch to Maintenance reminders and read the search box.
  3. Look for the "New customer" action on this tab.
  4. Look for a count badge on the Customers navigation item and on the Maintenance reminders tab.
  5. Click on the body of a row (not a button and not the three-dot menu).
  6. Scroll down to the bottom of the list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The list is a "Maintenance reminders" tab under Customers.
  • The search term typed on the Customers tab is still in the search box on this tab.
  • "New customer" belongs to the Customers tab and does not appear here.
  • Neither the Customers navigation item nor the Maintenance reminders tab carries a count badge.
  • Clicking the row body opens nothing; only the row's buttons and three-dot menu open things.
  • The first 50 rows show; scrolling to the bottom loads the remaining 16 (66 − 50) without any page buttons.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10570 (S13, The maintenance reminders worklist), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S13 (S13-R1, S13-R32, S13-N1, S13-R35, S13-R37); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R1: “The list will sit under Customers as a Maintenance reminders tab”
  • S13-R32: “The Customers page's search is shared by both tabs: a term typed on one stays when switching to the other”
  • S13-R32: “The New customer action belongs to the Customers tab and does not appear here”
  • S13-N1: “There is no count badge on the Customers nav item, nor on the Maintenance reminders tab”
  • S13-R35: “Rows open nothing. The row's buttons and its three-dot menu are the only way into anything from the list”
  • S13-R37: “The list loads 50 rows at a time from the server as the user scrolls, as the Work Orders list does”
  • S13-R11: “The list will be server side paged and sorted”
